items.title: Feathered Wing Scroll DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Wall Art
items.description: Free to cut, this design has large curling feather-like wing shapes cascade down the panel's center in tiers, framed by a classic scroll border. The layered wing tiers give the piece a soft, plume-like movement distinct from the more rigid floral medallions elsewhere in the collection.
